title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 17
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 17: Jehoshaphat's faithfulness, the teachers sent through Judah, and his mighty army.

questions.explanation: Yahweh was with him because he walked in the first ways of his father David and didn't seek the Baals.

answers.text: He made a treaty with the king of Israel against Syria
He built a larger temple for Yahweh in Jerusalem
He paid tribute to Egypt and to the Philistines
He walked in David's first ways and didn't seek the Baals

questions.text: What did Jehoshaphat have in abundance after all Judah brought him tribute?
questions.explanation: All Judah brought tribute to Jehoshaphat, and he had riches and honor in abundance.

questions.text: In which year of his reign did Jehoshaphat send his princes to teach in the cities of Judah?
questions.explanation: In the third year of his reign he sent his princes to teach in the cities of Judah.

questions.text: Which two priests went with the princes and Levites?
questions.explanation: With them were Elishama and Jehoram, the priests.

questions.text: What did the teachers have with them as they taught in Judah?
questions.explanation: They taught in Judah, having the book of Yahweh's law with them.

questions.text: Why did the kingdoms around Judah make no war against Jehoshaphat?
questions.explanation: The fear of Yahweh fell on all the kingdoms of the lands around Judah, so they made no war against him.

answers.text: He paid them silver every year
The fear of Yahweh fell on them
They were at war with Egypt

questions.text: Who brought Jehoshaphat flocks of rams and male goats?
questions.explanation: The Arabians brought him flocks: seven thousand seven hundred rams and seven thousand seven hundred male goats.

questions.text: Who was the captain from Judah with three hundred thousand mighty men of valor?
questions.explanation: From Judah, Adnah the captain had with him three hundred thousand mighty men of valor.

questions.text: What is said about Amasiah the son of Zichri?
questions.explanation: Amasiah the son of Zichri willingly offered himself to Yahweh.

answers.text: He willingly offered himself to Yahweh
He was a priest of the Baals
He was the king's eldest son
He came from the tribe of Benjamin

questions.text: With what were Eliada's two hundred thousand men from Benjamin armed?
questions.explanation: From Benjamin, Eliada had two hundred thousand armed with bow and shield.
